subject: Editorial coverage as an Ocean.io account field
body:
Ocean.io documents its filters and signals precisely: location, size, industry, technology, revenue, founding year, department size, LinkedIn headcount, plus hiring, funding, leadership change and headcount growth. None of them records which newsletters wrote about an account, which brands sponsor those newsletters, or whether a publication is gaining or losing momentum.

That is the field NewsletterFIT holds. An account comes back with the publications that covered it, the articles and dates behind them, the sponsors buying space in those publications, and a momentum figure computed from repeated audience snapshots rather than a single scrape.

An AI pass reads each issue, so the output is company, person, topic and sponsor records with provenance rather than text.

For a data buyer the join is the whole question: I can send a sample keyed by domain so you can test it against accounts you already rank.
